---
title: "Example: MSc thesis template (2-wave QA + attrition + LME + mediation)"
format: html
execute:
  echo: true
  warning: false
  message: false
---

source("R/msc_thesis_template.R")
set.seed(1)

# ---- Simulate long 2-wave data ----
n_id <- 120
ids <- sprintf("P%03d", 1:n_id)

df_tp1 <- data.frame(
  ID = ids,
  time_point = 1,
  Age = runif(n_id, 20, 82),
  Sex = sample(c("F","M"), n_id, replace = TRUE),
  ROI = rnorm(n_id, 1.5, 0.2),
  EM  = rnorm(n_id, 50, 6)
)

# dropout
returnee <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), n_id, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.55, 0.45))
df_tp2 <- df_tp1[returnee, ]
df_tp2$time_point <- 2
df_tp2$ROI <- df_tp2$ROI - rnorm(nrow(df_tp2), 0.05, 0.06)
df_tp2$EM  <- df_tp2$EM  - rnorm(nrow(df_tp2), 1.0,  2.0)

df_long <- rbind(df_tp1, df_tp2)

# ---- QA ----
df_long <- qa_make_age_corrected(df_long, id="ID", time_var="time_point", age_var="Age",
                                 followup_level=2, followup_increment=4)

df_long <- qa_make_age_groups(df_long, age_corrected_var="Age_Corrected",
                              breaks = seq(20, 90, 10))

dups <- qa_check_duplicates(df_long, id="ID", time_var="time_point")
nrow(dups)

cc <- qa_complete_case(df_long, required_vars = c("ID","time_point","Age_Corrected","Sex","ROI","EM"))
df_long_cc <- cc$df
cc$dropped_n

# ---- Attrition ----
df_long_cc <- attrition_status(df_long_cc, id="ID", time_var="time_point", followup_level=2)
attrition_summary(df_long_cc, id="ID", time_var="time_point")

# baseline selectivity tests (toy example)
df_base <- subset(df_long_cc, time_point == 1)
baseline_returnee_tests(
  df_baseline = df_base,
  status_var = "Status",
  vars_continuous = c("Age_Corrected","ROI","EM"),
  vars_categorical = c("Sex"),
  welch = TRUE,
  yates = TRUE
)

# ---- Wide + change scores ----
df_wide <- make_wide_two_wave(df_long_cc, id="ID", time_var="time_point", vars=c("ROI","EM"))
df_wide <- compute_change_set(df_wide, vars=c("ROI","EM"), method="pct")

head(df_wide)

# one paired t-test (toy)
stats::t.test(df_wide$EM_TP2, df_wide$EM_TP1, paired = TRUE)

# one correlation (toy)
stats::cor.test(df_wide$ROI_TP1, df_wide$Change_ROI)

# ---- LME example ----
# use long-format, random intercept
lme_res <- fit_lme_safely(EM ~ Sex * time_point + Age_Corrected + (1|ID), data=df_long_cc, reml=FALSE)
lme_res$warns
fit <- lme_res$fit
summary(fit)

# lightweight diagnostics (plots)
# lme_basic_diagnostics(fit)

# ---- Mediation demo (small sims for speed; thesis used larger sims) ----
# wide-format mediation on change variables (toy)
df_med <- df_wide
df_med$Sex_num <- as.numeric(factor(df_long_cc[df_long_cc$time_point==1,"Sex"], levels=c("F","M")))

mediation_decompose(
  df = df_med,
  treat = "Sex_num",
  mediator = "Change_ROI",
  outcome = "Change_EM",
  covariates = NULL,
  sims = 300,
  seed = 123
)

dir.create("analysis/_demo_outputs", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
write.csv(attrition_summary(df_long_cc, "ID", "time_point"),
          "analysis/_demo_outputs/attrition_summary.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
